Public relay directory

Find participating relays and see whether they are still sending heartbeats and reachable on the network.

How the relay tiers work

Tiers describe operational confidence, not popularity. Relays are alphabetical by hostname inside each tier.

Tier 1 — Heartbeat + Online
These relays send a directory heartbeat and were reachable at the latest check.
Tier 2 — Online, no current heartbeat
These relays are known to the directory and were reachable at the latest check, but do not currently send a directory heartbeat.
Tier 3 — Offline / Unreachable
These relays could not be reached at the latest check but have been seen online within the last six months.
Tier 4 — Graveyard
These relays have not been seen online for at least six months. They remain listed for historical reference and are checked periodically in case they return.
